title: Spectral theory of energy-selective quantum search with Ising Hamiltonian phase oracles
summary: We develop an exact spectral-response theory for the Grover-type iterate \(W_T=D_ξ\exp(-\mathrm{i} T H)\), in which the evolution generated by a diagonal Ising Hamiltonian is used directly as a continuous phase oracle. An energy-grouped recurrence and its generating-function solution show how the empirical characteristic function determines the position, width, height, and saturation time of an energy-selective resonance. For an annealed Gaussian density of states, a high-density-tail resonance containing \(M\) configurations is reached after \(Θ(\sqrt{2^n/M})\) oracle calls with success…
